Spend £75 or more on qualifying STANLEY or STANLEY FATMAX hand tools or storage products to claim a FREE STANLEY FATMAX XTREME 120cm Box Beam Level (FMHT43676-1). UK & ROI residents aged 18+ only. Purchase on or between 01.09.2026 - 24.11.2026. Claim online at STANLEYtools.co.uk by 07.12.2026 with proof of purchase. 5,000 available, first come, first served. Full T&Cs apply. Manufacturer promotion.

The Stanley FatMax Deep Pro organiser delivers robust, weather-resistant storage for trade professionals and DIY enthusiasts. Constructed from durable polycarbonate, this heavy duty organiser features a hinged lid with plastic clamps and four securing latches, keeping contents secure and protected from the elements. It includes two large and eight medium compartments that are removable to allow flexible customisation for small parts, fixings, or components. Offers a maximum load capacity of 8kg, with a sturdy carrying handle ensuring easy transportation. Multiple units can clip together. Ideal for organising various fittings on site and in the workshop.
